title: Evidence for episodic and patchy mass ejection in the circumstellar envelope of AGB star R Leonis
question: What is the morpho-kinematics and relative molecular abundance distribution of the circumstellar envelope of the oxygen-rich AGB star R Leonis across radial scales from the stellar disc to a few arcseconds?

evidence.quote: In our analysis we use 114 pc, a value consistent with the distance obtained from the period-luminosity relation (cite: Haniff1995).

what.value: Star systemic velocity of -0.5 km s^-1

evidence.quote: The Doppler velocity $V_\text{z}$ spectrum is centred on a star systemic velocity of $-$0.5 km s$^{-1}$ (cite: Teyssier2006), which, however, is not known to better than $\sim$$\pm$0.5 km s$^{-1}$.

what.value: Single-dish relative molecular abundances for CO, 29SiO, H13CN, SO, SO2

evidence.quote: We also list, in the same table, abundances obtained from single dish observations using broad and isotropic radial distributions.

external_data.citation: Table 5 references (a, b, c, e, g)

recipe.goal: Phase-centre shift, self-calibration, and continuum/line imaging
recipe.method: Shift the phase centre of the Band 6 high-resolution visibilities to the centre of the continuum emission, perform phase self-calibration on the continuum data, apply the solutions to the line data, and produce cleaned images without visibility-level continuum subtraction.

recipe.goal: Morpho-kinematic analysis of the expanding CO(2-1) shell and quantification of inhomogeneity
recipe.method: Construct channel maps, radial intensity profiles, position-velocity (V_z vs R and V_z vs omega) maps, and distributions of the elliptical shell parameter rho = sqrt((V_z/5.5)^2 + (R/6)^2). Divide the shell into twelve 30-degree position angle sectors and compute the rms deviation from unity of the ratio of each sector's rho distribution to the mean distribution.
key_parameters: Shell mean radius = 6 arcsec, mean expansion velocity = 5.5 km s^-1, 12 sectors of 30 deg width, intervals |rho - 1| < 0.25 and |rho - 1| < 0.5

recipe.goal: Kinematic and intensity characterization of three inner outflows (SE, SW, NW)
recipe.method: Define three 3D data cube regions (SE, SW, NW) between R = 60 and 300 mas, each with volume 0.48 arcsec^2 km s^-1, and compute the integrated intensity, mean and rms Doppler velocity <V_z>, and mean and rms position angle <omega> for CO(2-1), 29SiO(5-4), SO(5_5-4_4), SO2(22_2,20-22_1,21), and SO2(13_2,12-12_1,11)/H13CN(4-3).
key_parameters: Radial range: 60 to 300 mas; cube volume: 0.48 arcsec^2 km s^-1; SE: -5 < V_z < 2 km s^-1, 90 < omega < 180 deg; SW: -2 < V_z < 5 km s^-1, 180 < omega < 270 deg; NW: -2 < V_z < 5 km s^-1, 270 < omega < 360 deg

recipe.goal: Derive relative molecular abundances in the inner outflows under LTE approximation
recipe.method: Calculate the ratio of observed intensity in each region (SE, SW, NW) to the LTE factor F = A_ji (2J+1) k exp(-E_u/T) evaluated at T = 1000 K, and normalize to the 29SiO abundance as reference.
assumptions: LTE approximation, optically thin (neglecting absorption in 60-300 mas), T = 1000 K

recipe.goal: Analyze vibrationally excited SiO maser emission and geometry
recipe.method: Map channel maps, PV diagrams, and Doppler velocity spectra integrated within R < 0.3 arcsec and over the stellar disc (R < 30 mas and 30 < R < 50 mas) for 28SiO(v=1,5-4), 28SiO(v=2,5-4), and 28SiO(v=1,8-7), and compare line ratios with LTE predictions.
key_parameters: Expansion velocity = 10.6 km s^-1 (from Vlemmings 2019), observed |V_z| ~ 6 km s^-1
assumptions: Actual expansion velocity of SiO maser layer equals the 10.6 km s^-1 continuum expansion velocity from Vlemmings (2019)

score_reason: Public archival data, explicit target/phase-centre coordinates, clear weighting and beam/channel tables (Table 1), and explicit equations and region bounds (Tables 2 and 4) for the LTE and kinematic analyses; minor deductions for unstated self-calibration and deconvolution parameters.
